primaryTextChecks.text: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

context.text: After him Jair, the Gileadite, arose. He judged Israel twenty-two years.
Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.
